scope: Data/calendar layer; full ledger/UI integration is recorded by root integration tests, not asserted here.
runtime_limitations: Full historical calendars and reference records are external observations; scenario calendar supports2012-2030 only.
Real archive duplicate logical partitions remain unresolved and are never selected silently.
No claimed automatic IV-unit identification without explicit metadata or a supplied unique repricing acceptance function.
Known standard deliverable metadata is absent in audited real sample; historical quote view works but strict new-order permission stays unavailable.
Actual source trade-condition numeric codes have no supplied meaning, so unknown conditions cannot authorize fills.
Mirrors are optional explicit cache artifacts; large gzip inputs use bounded streaming when raw cache would exceed budget.
conditional_scope: Archive acquisition/repair requires a separate explicit task; no source repair or network download is performed.

owned_test_run.command: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_data_catalog_updates.py tests/test_data.py tests/test_data_edge_cases.py tests/test_calendar.py tests/test_action_generator.py tests/test_path_iv.py tests/test_probability_quality.py tests/test_reference_wizard.py tests/test_risk_review.py tests/test_risk_universe.py tests/test_replay_integration.py -q --basetemp=D:\optionsimulation\.tmp\pytest-agent-final8
owned_test_run.meaning: Focused regression coverage; this is not full specification or production qualification.

covered: Empty DEFAULT_SYMBOL startup context, fixed-symbol convenience, e/undo/done navigation, three trade stages, cancellation and checkpoint retention.
Canonical exact position IDs, original existing cash and frozen target, hypothetical net midpoint basis, unmatched overrides ignored without cross-position leakage.
Numeric percentage normalization, mandatory50percent, NY calendar-day offsets preserving wall time across DST, outside-horizon reporting without clamping.
Dated symbol/expiration market overrides, normalized annual decimals, explicit contract IV overrides and source provenance.
Explicit product root and eligible interval subset; unsupported fields or sessions outside underlying/option intersection reject.
Fixed-cost closing-only net companion from the separate gross-equivalent threshold; gross headline unchanged and terminal net probability null without a terminal cost convention.

model_input_quality.spot: Current completed authoritative QQQ candle required; prior substitution disabled.
model_input_quality.minute_precision: Worst age is D-M; uncertainty interval contributes to dispersion without adding another60seconds to age.
model_input_quality.local_atm_fallback: Causal weighted-median estimator wired into risk_job and wizard, requiring separately qualified packed prices, compatible normalized vendor/scenario IVs, positive validated vega, at least4contracts/2strikes/bothrights, nearest10 within log5percent, cappedweights and dispersion gate. No online offline-engine import.
model_input_quality.limitations: Fallback cannot invent missing/ambiguous IVs. Iterative inverse pricing remains an explicit offline operation. Real archived IV mapping and model basis remain unqualified until input evidence and pack gates pass.

managed_encoder.schema: EXACT_TOKENS_ACCOUNT_KINK_SHOCK_ACTION_V2: HOLD950, managed state1000, action1365. Universe remains512x16 tokens, shared16-64-64 SiLU and masked pooled154features.
managed_encoder.tests: 32 focused feature/universe tests: permutation invariance, future/unknown listing rejection, online/trainable parity, joint-training gradients, action limits/fees/stop/order-type/TIF distinctions, exact eligibility/expiry clocks, actual account evidence and transition refresh without prior-state mutation, typed malformed context, legacy-contract rejection, gross/net kink and executable target gaps, shock availability masks and missingness-regime abstention.
managed_encoder.qualification: Encoding tests do not qualify numerical model outputs; old feature packs require explicit rebuild and independent validation.

bounded_action_generator.coverage: Whole-ratio and defined-risk paired reductions, protective longs, same-right butterflies, deterministic family pools and unused quota redistribution, exact net atomic transactions and full resulting-state action identities.
bounded_action_generator.limits: At most2000 retained candidates and40000 attempted tuples, explicit truncation reasons; finite bounded search does not establish global optimality or qualify production policy probabilities.

immutable_analytic_records.coverage: Frozen full request and source snapshot; separate content hashes; bounded immutable memory cache; immutable/idempotent result storage; exact duplicate result retrieval; missing-pack and preparation-error records; late original-branch and closed-original-session archival; pending/completed/null-reason exports; restore and tamper checks; no economic state-version or ledger changes.
immutable_analytic_records.limits: Persistence tests do not qualify numerical model outputs. Initial-fill benchmark inputs remain committed atomically with their own economic transaction and explicitly bypass separate analytic registration. A deliberate retry after an archived terminal failure needs a new request attempt identity.

last_trade_visibility.coverage: Cached temporal index and streaming fallback agree; minute-only trades appear at completion; corrections/cancellations apply only when known; equal-time conflicting prices without reliable source order are null with AMBIGUOUS_LAST_TRADE_ORDER; unknown conditions remain display-only quality observations.
last_trade_visibility.barrier: Event-granular records published exactly atD are phase30 and excluded from the phase25 snapshot. Minute completions atD are phase20 and included. An explicit delayed publication beyond minute completion is phase30.
last_trade_visibility.actual_data: The real selected trades have subminute source timestamps while the default shared options mapping declaresminute; TIMESTAMP_PRECISION_CONFLICT is exposed until a per-kind explicit mapping is supplied. Unknown numeric trade conditions cannot authorize fills or trade-derived volume.
last_trade_visibility.performance: 2012-06-01:10:01cold0.858s,10:02/03warm0.101/0.103s,15:58first2.562s,15:59warm0.726s. These are individual bounded measurements, not a p95 qualification. Source hashes remained unchanged.

reviewed_requirements.detail: Directory-only mtime polling at most twice per second detects new files/folders, including formerly empty directories. Unbound views rescan automatically; adding any source partition to a bound day latches DATA_REVISION_CHANGED until a new data service/run. Selected-file mutation checks remain immediate.

Atomic persisted catalog includes path/type/dates/size/mtime, sourcehash, schema fingerprint, normalizationversion, row/contract counts, earliest/latest raw times, quality, audit time and optional mirror identity. Unknown fields stay null until bounded audit. Reuse requires exact source-root pair and normalization identity plus unchanged file size/mtime; binding still computes original SHA256.

Raw vendor Greeks are preserved. Separate normalized fields accept explicit delta decimal/percent, gamma per-dollar, theta per-day/ACT365-year, vega/rho/epsilon per-unit/per1percent, including explicit per-contract scale. Unknown higher-order/unit conventions remain unverified and are never guessed.

reviewed_requirements.requirement: Historical archive and model profile production qualification
reviewed_requirements.detail: Real sample contains unverified IV units/contract metadata and duplicate OI partitions. Historical rate/carry/fixing records and a qualified production price/hold/managed pack are not established by this data audit. Synthetic tests and one-day performance evidence do not qualify the complete archive.
